SELECT
, c.name AS category_name FROM news n LEFT JOIN news_category c ON c.id = n.category_id WHERE n.status = 1
AND n.category_id = #{category_id}
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.ai_keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.origin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC, n.id DESC
SELECT id, title, image_url, link_url, news_id, sort, enable FROM banner WHERE enable = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id DESC

SELECT
, c.name AS category_name , ua.create_time AS favorite_time FROM user_action ua INNER JOIN news n ON n.id = ua.target_id AND n.status = 1 LEFT JOIN news_category c ON c.id = n.category_id WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId} AND ua.target_type = 1 ORDER BY ua.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.origin, n.source_url, n.publish_time, n.crawl_time, n.category_id, n.ai_summary, n.ai_keywords, n.ai_status, n.ai_model, n.ai_tokens, n.status, n.slider, n.read_count, n.like_count, n.comment_count, c.name AS category_name FROM news n LEFT JOIN news_category c ON c.id = n.category_id
AND n.status = #{status} AND n.category_id = #{categoryId} AND n.ai_status = #{aiStatus}
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.origin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY n.id DESC
